GA001.explanation: Article 32 of the Indian Constitution confers the Right to Constitutional Remedies, which Dr. B.R. Ambedkar called the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution.

GA002.explanation: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Truth-Seekers' Society) in Pune in 1873 to champion social equity and education.

GA003.explanation: The Duncan Passage is a strait in the Indian Ocean that separates South Andaman (Rutland Island) to the north and Little Andaman to the south.

GA004.explanation: NABARD was established on 12 July 1982 on the recommendations of the B. Sivaraman Committee (CRAFICARD).

GA005.explanation: Atmospheric refraction of starlight passing through air layers of gradually changing refractive indices causes the apparent twinkling of stars.

GA006.explanation: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1976 added Part IVA (Article 51A) containing Fundamental Duties based on the Swaran Singh Committee recommendations.

GA007.explanation: The 69th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1991 inserted Articles 239AA and 239AB, designating Delhi as the National Capital Territory with a Legislative Assembly.

GA008.explanation: The Sutlej River originates from Rakshastal (Rakas Lake) near Lake Mansarovar in Tibet and enters Himachal Pradesh via the Shipki La pass.

GA009.explanation: The SI unit of magnetic flux density (magnetic induction B) is Tesla (T), equal to one Weber per square metre (Wb/m²).

GA010.explanation: Major Rock Edict XIII records Emperor Ashoka's remorse over the Kalinga War casualties and his subsequent embrace of Dhamma.

GA011.explanation: Sattriya was introduced in the 15th century AD by Srimanta Sankardeva in Assam and is one of the eight recognized classical dances of India.

GA012.explanation: The Montreal Protocol (1987) is a landmark multilateral environmental agreement that regulates the production and consumption of ozone-depleting substances (ODS).

GA013.explanation: A reduction in the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) leaves commercial banks with larger Vault/NDDTL liquidity, increasing their credit creation and lending capacity.

GA014.explanation: Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) is a water-soluble vitamin essential for the hydroxylation of proline and lysine during collagen biosynthesis.

GA015.explanation: Under Article 118(4) of the Indian Constitution, the Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over a joint sitting of the two Houses of Parliament.

HIN001.explanation: 'आशीर्वाद' शुद्ध वर्तनी है क्योंकि रेफ ('र्') का उच्चारण 'व' से पूर्व होता है, अतः वह 'वा' के ऊपर लगता है।

HIN002.explanation: 'प्रत्युपकार' (प्रति + उपकार) में 'इ' के बाद भिन्न स्वर 'उ' आने पर 'यु' हो गया है, जो यण स्वर संधि का नियम है।

HIN003.explanation: जब दोनों पद मिलकर किसी तीसरे विशेष अर्थ (श्रीकृष्ण/विष्णु) की ओर संकेत करते हैं, तब वहाँ बहुव्रीहि समास होता है।

HIN004.explanation: 'गागर में सागर भरना' का अर्थ थोड़े शब्दों में गहन एवं विस्तृत भाव व्यक्त करना है।

HIN005.explanation: 'स्थावर' (स्थिर रहने वाला) का सटीक विलोम शब्द 'जंगम' (चलने-फिरने वाला) होता है।

HIN006.explanation: 'जलद' (जल देने वाला) बादल का पर्यायवाची है, जबकि राजीव, अरविन्द और पंकज कमल के पर्यायवाची हैं।

HIN007.explanation: 'जिसे प्रमाण द्वारा सिद्ध न किया जा सके' उसे 'अप्रमेय' कहते हैं।

HIN008.explanation: 'अभ्यागत' (अभि + आगत) में 'अभि' उपसर्ग प्रयुक्त हुआ है।

HIN009.explanation: 'अग्नि' संस्कृत का मूल तत्सम शब्द है, जिसका तद्भव रूप 'आग' होता है।

HIN010.explanation: जहाँ किसी वस्तु का किसी स्थान से अलग होने (पृथकता) का भाव प्रकट हो, वहाँ अपादान कारक होता है।

HIN011.explanation: यहाँ 'कनक' शब्द की आवृत्ति दो बार भिन्न-भिन्न अर्थों (सोना तथा धतूरा) में हुई है, अतः यमक अलंकार है।

HIN012.explanation: 'यद्यपि... तथापि' से जुड़े आश्रित उपवाक्य वाले वाक्य रचना की दृष्टि से मिश्र वाक्य कहलाते हैं।

HIN013.explanation: 'जगन्नाथ' का सही संधि-विच्छेद 'जगत् + नाथ' (व्यंजन संधि) है।

HIN014.explanation: 'अधजल गगरी छलकत जाए' लोकोक्ति का अर्थ अल्पज्ञानी या कम गुण वाले व्यक्ति द्वारा अधिक दिखावा करना है।

HIN015.explanation: 'उत् + ज्वल' से बनने वाले शब्द की शुद्ध वर्तनी 'उज्ज्वल' (दोनों 'ज्' आधे) होती है।

ENG001.explanation: With 'Neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject ('the teachers', plural), and 'yesterday' requires past tense 'were'.

ENG002.explanation: 'Ephemeral' means lasting for a very short time (short-lived or transitory).

ENG003.explanation: 'To burn the midnight oil' means to read, study, or work late into the night.

ENG004.explanation: Present continuous active ('is reviewing') transforms into 'is/am/are + being + past participle' ('is being reviewed').

ENG005.explanation: 'Mitigate' means to make less severe; its antonym is 'Aggravate' (to make worse or more severe).

ENG006.explanation: A 'Polyglot' is a person who knows and is able to use several languages.

ENG007.explanation: The verb 'exempt' takes the fixed preposition 'from' ('exempted from').

ENG008.explanation: When the reported clause states a universal scientific truth ('Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius'), its tense remains unchanged in indirect speech.

ENG009.explanation: 'Accommodation' is spelled with a double 'c' and a double 'm'.

ENG010.explanation: The correlative conjunction pair is 'Hardly/Scarcely... when' (not 'than', which pairs with 'No sooner').

ENG011.explanation: In a Third Conditional sentence ('would have + V3' in the main clause), the if-clause requires the past perfect tense ('had studied').

ENG012.explanation: 'Pragmatic' means dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a practical manner.

ENG013.explanation: The phrasal verb 'call off' means to cancel a planned event or action.

ENG014.explanation: 'M.Tech' begins with a vowel sound (/ɛm/), so it takes the indefinite article 'an'.

ENG015.explanation: The verb 'prefer' takes the preposition 'to' rather than 'than' when comparing two nouns or gerunds.

TM001.explanation: In the 2001 revised Bloom's Taxonomy by Anderson & Krathwohl, 'Creating' sits at the apex above 'Evaluating'.

TM002.explanation: Vygotsky defined the ZPD as the distance between actual developmental level (independent problem solving) and potential development with scaffolding.

TM003.explanation: NEP 2020 replaces the 10+2 structure with a 5+3+3+4 curricular and pedagogical structure covering ages 3 to 18.

TM004.explanation: Formative assessment ('Assessment for Learning') occurs continuously during instruction to diagnose and improve learning.

TM005.explanation: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016 expanded the number of recognized benchmark disabilities from 7 to 21.

TM006.explanation: Dry-running trace tables with visual state transitions builds mental models of call stacks and variable mutations rather than rote memorization.

TM007.explanation: B.F. Skinner formulated Operant Conditioning, demonstrating how behavior is shaped by reinforcement and punishment schedules.

TM008.explanation: According to the NCERT Indian Model of Micro-Teaching, the complete cycle takes 36 minutes (Teach 6m, Feedback 6m, Re-plan 12m, Re-teach 6m, Re-feedback 6m).

TM009.explanation: In Piaget's theory, hypothetico-deductive reasoning and abstract thought emerge during the Formal Operational Stage (11+ years).

TM010.explanation: SWAYAM is the Government of India's national MOOC platform offering interactive courses from Class 9 to post-graduation.

TM011.explanation: Diagnostic testing pinpoints specific conceptual misconceptions and underlying causes of learning difficulties prior to remedial instruction.

TM012.explanation: Engaging in an activity for inherent satisfaction rather than external reward exemplifies Intrinsic Motivation.

TM013.explanation: The RTE Act, 2009 (under Article 21A) mandates free and compulsory elementary education for children aged 6 to 14 years.

TM014.explanation: Direct purposeful hands-on experience forms the base of Edgar Dale's Cone of Experience, yielding the deepest comprehension and retention.

TM015.explanation: Reliability refers to the consistency and stability of assessment scores across repeated administrations.

CS001.explanation: In a singly linked list of n nodes, linear traversal from the head is required in the worst case, resulting in O(n) time complexity.

CS002.explanation: FIFO (First-In, First-Out) page replacement can exhibit Belady's Anomaly, where increasing page frames increases page faults. Stack algorithms like LRU and Optimal do not.

CS003.explanation: A relation is in BCNF if for every non-trivial functional dependency X -> Y, the determinant X is a superkey of the relation.

CS004.explanation: Routers operate at Layer 3 (Network Layer) of the OSI model, inspecting logical IP headers to determine optimal routing paths.

CS005.explanation: +13 in 8-bit binary is 00001101. Inverting bits gives 11110010 (1's complement), and adding 1 yields 11110011.

CS006.explanation: Root is A. Left subtree inorder [D, B, E] with root B gives postorder [D, E, B]. Right subtree inorder [F, C] with root C gives [F, C]. Combined postorder: [D, E, B, F, C, A].

CS007.explanation: Coffman's four deadlock conditions are Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, and Circular Wait. 'Preemption' prevents deadlock.

CS008.explanation: A /26 subnet leaves 32 - 26 = 6 host bits, providing 2^6 - 2 = 64 - 2 = 62 usable host IP addresses.

CS009.explanation: In `range(5)`, the odd numbers are 1 and 3. Squaring them produces `[1, 9]`.

CS010.explanation: The HAVING clause filters grouped rows after aggregation, whereas WHERE filters individual rows prior to grouping.

CS011.explanation: McCabe's cyclomatic complexity formula for a control flow graph is V(G) = E - N + 2P.

CS012.explanation: Deterministic Pushdown Automata (DPDA) recognize Deterministic Context-Free Languages (DCFL), which are a proper subset of all Context-Free Languages.

CS013.explanation: Runtime polymorphism (late binding) in C++ is implemented via virtual functions dispatched through a vtable using base class pointers or references.

CS014.explanation: A minimum of four 2-input NAND gates is required to construct a 2-input XOR gate.

CS015.explanation: Insertion Sort and Bubble Sort with an early-termination swap flag achieve O(n) best-case time complexity on an already sorted array.

CS016.explanation: EMAT = Hit Ratio × Cache Time + (1 - Hit Ratio) × Miss Penalty Time = 0.90 × 10 + 0.10 × 100 = 9 + 10 = 19 ns.

CS017.explanation: HTTP 403 Forbidden means the server understood the request, but refuses to authorize it regardless of authentication.

CS018.explanation: TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) is connection-oriented and establishes sessions using a three-way handshake (SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK).

CS019.explanation: Durability guarantees that committed transaction updates survive subsequent system failures using write-ahead logging and non-volatile storage.

CS020.explanation: SJF order: P2 (2ms, waits 0ms) -> P3 (4ms, waits 2ms) -> P1 (6ms, waits 6ms). Average waiting time = (0 + 2 + 6) / 3 = 8 / 3 = 2.67 ms.

CS021.explanation: In a 0-indexed binary heap array, the left child of index i is at 2i + 1 and the right child is at 2i + 2.

CS022.explanation: SQL Injection (SQLi) occurs when untrusted user input is directly concatenated into dynamic SQL statements without prepared statements.

CS023.explanation: The Syntax Analyzer (Parser) consumes tokens from the lexer and verifies grammatical structure by building a parse tree or AST.

CS024.explanation: When both J = 1 and K = 1, the JK flip-flop complements (toggles) its current output state Q(t+1) = Q'(t).

CS025.explanation: Tuples are immutable sequences in Python and are hashable (valid dictionary keys) provided all their elements are also hashable.

REA001.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by +1 position in the English alphabet: A->B, L->M, G->H, O->P, R->S, I->J, T->U, H->I, M->N (BMHPSJUIN).

REA003.explanation: From 'All processors are circuits' and 'Some circuits are registers', there is no definite overlap between processors and registers, nor are all registers circuits.

REA004.explanation: The only son of Rohan's grandfather is Rohan's father. The daughter of Rohan's father is Rohan's sister.

REA005.explanation: Net northward displacement = 10 - 2 = 8 km; eastward displacement = 6 km. Distance = √(8² + 6²) = √(64 + 36) = 10 km.

REA006.explanation: The pattern is n : n² + 1. Since 12² + 1 = 145, for 15 we have 15² + 1 = 225 + 1 = 226.

REA007.explanation: From left to right facing North, the seating order is P - T - S - Q - R. Therefore, S is sitting in the middle.

REA008.explanation: BDFH, JLNP, and SUWY follow a uniform +2, +2, +2 letter gap, whereas MOQT has +2, +2, +3.

REA009.explanation: Position from right end = Total - Left position + 1 = 45 - 18 + 1 = 28th.

MAT002.explanation: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day. Time taken together = 36/5 = 7.2 days.

MAT003.explanation: Multiply A : B = 3 : 4 by 2 to match B = 8, giving A : B = 6 : 8. Thus A : B : C = 6 : 8 : 9.

MAT004.explanation: Total marks of 15 students = 15 × 68 = 1020. Excluding 96 leaves 924 for 14 students. New average = 924 / 14 = 66.

MAT005.explanation: Cost Price = 720 / 0.90 = Rs. 800. Selling price for 15% gain = 800 × 1.15 = Rs. 920.

MAT007.explanation: Speed = 72 km/hr = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Time = 180 m / 20 m/s = 9 seconds.

MAT008.explanation: 72 = 36 × 2, 108 = 36 × 3, 180 = 36 × 5. Hence the Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 36.

MAT009.explanation: Side of square = Diagonal / √2 = 12 cm. Perimeter = 4 × 12 = 48 cm.
